snippet.title: Crimson Desert - Charting the Unknown DLC Reveal Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP4162-PPSA25286_00-DLCA000000000000
 
Your journey across Pywel continues in Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown, an upcoming DLC arriving October 15, 2026. Pre-order now on the PlayStation Store.
 
(This gameplay trailer contains actual in-game footage captured on PlayStation 5 Pro. As a work-in-progress, the content is subject to change.)
 
Reclaim power and reach beyond—into the unknown.
The story of Pywel continues in Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown as Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane set out to discover their purpose and shape their futures. However, as turmoil unfolds around them, each must fight to forge a path through the trials ahead. Join them on a new adventure and discover what new possibilities await across Pywel.
 
 #ps5 #ps5games #stateofplay #CrimsonDesert #붉은사막

Rated Mature
